title: Der neue Job — The New Job
summary: Thomas starts a new job in Berlin and talks about his first week.

paragraphs.text: Vor zwei Wochen hat Thomas eine neue Stelle in Berlin angenommen.
paragraphs.translation: Two weeks ago Thomas accepted a new position in Berlin.
paragraphs.translation_en: Two weeks ago Thomas accepted a new position in Berlin.
paragraphs.translation_id: Dua minggu lalu Thomas menerima posisi baru di Berlin.

paragraphs.text: Seine Firma entwickelt Software für kleine Unternehmen.
paragraphs.translation: His company develops software for small businesses.
paragraphs.translation_en: His company develops software for small businesses.
paragraphs.translation_id: Perusahaannya mengembangkan perangkat lunak untuk usaha kecil.

paragraphs.text: Am ersten Tag hat ihn sein Kollege Peter herumgeführt und die wichtigsten Abteilungen gezeigt.
paragraphs.translation: On the first day his colleague Peter showed him around and presented the most important departments.
paragraphs.translation_en: On the first day his colleague Peter showed him around and presented the most important departments.
paragraphs.translation_id: Di hari pertama rekannya Peter mengajaknya keliling dan memperkenalkan departemen-departemen terpenting.

paragraphs.text: Das Team arbeitet viel im Homeoffice, aber freitags sind alle im Büro.
paragraphs.translation: The team works a lot from home, but on Fridays everyone is in the office.
paragraphs.translation_en: The team works a lot from home, but on Fridays everyone is in the office.
paragraphs.translation_id: Tim banyak bekerja dari rumah, tapi setiap Jumat semua di kantor.

paragraphs.text: Thomas findet die Aufgaben interessant, obwohl der Weg zur Arbeit lang ist.
paragraphs.translation: Thomas finds the tasks interesting, although the commute is long.
paragraphs.translation_en: Thomas finds the tasks interesting, although the commute is long.
paragraphs.translation_id: Thomas merasa tugasnya menarik, meskipun perjalanan ke kantornya panjang.

paragraphs.text: Er hofft, dass er sich bald gut in das Team integriert.
paragraphs.translation: He hopes that he will soon integrate well into the team.
paragraphs.translation_en: He hopes that he will soon integrate well into the team.
paragraphs.translation_id: Dia berharap segera bisa berbaur dengan baik dalam tim.

summary_en: Thomas starts a new job in Berlin and talks about his first week.
summary_id: Thomas memulai pekerjaan baru di Berlin dan bercerita tentang minggu pertamanya.

title: Ein Urlaub in den Bergen — A Holiday in the Mountains
summary: A family spends a week in the Bavarian Alps and discovers hiking.

paragraphs.text: Im letzten Sommer haben wir eine Woche in den bayerischen Alpen verbracht.
paragraphs.translation: Last summer we spent a week in the Bavarian Alps.
paragraphs.translation_en: Last summer we spent a week in the Bavarian Alps.
paragraphs.translation_id: Musim panas lalu kami menghabiskan seminggu di Pegunungan Alpen Bavaria.

paragraphs.text: Wir hatten ein kleines Ferienhaus mit Blick auf den See gebucht.
paragraphs.translation: We had booked a small holiday house with a view of the lake.
paragraphs.translation_en: We had booked a small holiday house with a view of the lake.
paragraphs.translation_id: Kami memesan rumah liburan kecil dengan pemandangan danau.

paragraphs.text: Jeden Morgen sind wir nach dem Frühstück eine andere Route gewandert.
paragraphs.translation: Every morning after breakfast we hiked a different route.
paragraphs.translation_en: Every morning after breakfast we hiked a different route.
paragraphs.translation_id: Setiap pagi setelah sarapan kami mendaki rute yang berbeda.

paragraphs.text: Mein Sohn hatte anfangs Angst vor den steilen Wegen, aber bald hat er die Berge geliebt.
paragraphs.translation: My son was afraid of the steep paths at first, but soon he loved the mountains.
paragraphs.translation_en: My son was afraid of the steep paths at first, but soon he loved the mountains.
paragraphs.translation_id: Anak saya awalnya takut dengan jalan terjal, tapi tak lama kemudian dia menyukai pegunungan.

paragraphs.text: Am letzten Abend haben wir auf der Terrasse gegrillt und den Sonnenuntergang beobachtet.
paragraphs.translation: On the last evening we grilled on the terrace and watched the sunset.
paragraphs.translation_en: On the last evening we grilled on the terrace and watched the sunset.
paragraphs.translation_id: Malam terakhir kami memanggang di teras dan menonton matahari terbenam.

paragraphs.text: Wir sind uns sicher, dass wir nächstes Jahr wiederkommen werden.
paragraphs.translation: We are sure that we will come back next year.
paragraphs.translation_en: We are sure that we will come back next year.
paragraphs.translation_id: Kami yakin tahun depan akan kembali lagi.

summary_en: A family spends a week in the Bavarian Alps and discovers hiking.
summary_id: Sebuah keluarga menghabiskan seminggu di Pegunungan Alpen Bavaria dan menemukan kegiatan mendaki.

title: Nachhaltigkeit im Alltag — Sustainability in Everyday Life
summary: Why more and more Germans try to live more sustainably.

paragraphs.text: Immer mehr Menschen in Deutschland versuchen, nachhaltiger zu leben.
paragraphs.translation: More and more people in Germany try to live more sustainably.
paragraphs.translation_en: More and more people in Germany try to live more sustainably.
paragraphs.translation_id: Semakin banyak orang di Jerman mencoba hidup lebih berkelanjutan.

paragraphs.text: Sie kaufen regionale Produkte und verzichten auf Plastikverpackungen.
paragraphs.translation: They buy regional products and avoid plastic packaging.
paragraphs.translation_en: They buy regional products and avoid plastic packaging.
paragraphs.translation_id: Mereka membeli produk lokal dan menghindari kemasan plastik.

paragraphs.text: Viele benutzen das Fahrrad anstatt des Autos, besonders in den Städten.
paragraphs.translation: Many use the bicycle instead of the car, especially in the cities.
paragraphs.translation_en: Many use the bicycle instead of the car, especially in the cities.
paragraphs.translation_id: Banyak orang memakai sepeda alih-alih mobil, terutama di kota-kota.

paragraphs.text: Einige Firmen haben ihre Verpackungen bereits auf Papier umgestellt.
paragraphs.translation: Some companies have already switched their packaging to paper.
paragraphs.translation_en: Some companies have already switched their packaging to paper.
paragraphs.translation_id: Sebagian perusahaan sudah mengganti kemasan mereka ke kertas.

paragraphs.text: Trotzdem ist es nicht immer einfach, umweltbewusst zu handeln.
paragraphs.translation: Nevertheless, it is not always easy to act in an environmentally conscious way.
paragraphs.translation_en: Nevertheless, it is not always easy to act in an environmentally conscious way.
paragraphs.translation_id: Meski begitu, tidak selalu mudah untuk bertindak ramah lingkungan.

paragraphs.text: Experten sagen, dass jeder kleine Schritt zählt.
paragraphs.translation: Experts say that every small step counts.
paragraphs.translation_en: Experts say that every small step counts.
paragraphs.translation_id: Para ahli mengatakan setiap langkah kecil berarti.

summary_en: Why more and more Germans try to live more sustainably.
summary_id: Mengapa semakin banyak orang Jerman mencoba hidup lebih berkelanjutan.

title: Gesund bleiben — Staying Healthy
summary: How Germans take care of their health through sport, food and sleep.

paragraphs.text: Gesundheit spielt in Deutschland eine große Rolle im Alltag.
paragraphs.translation: Health plays a big role in everyday life in Germany.
paragraphs.translation_en: Health plays a big role in everyday life in Germany.
paragraphs.translation_id: Kesehatan memegang peran besar dalam kehidupan sehari-hari di Jerman.

paragraphs.text: Viele Menschen treiben regelmäßig Sport, etwa Joggen, Schwimmen oder Fußball.
paragraphs.translation: Many people exercise regularly, such as jogging, swimming or football.
paragraphs.translation_en: Many people exercise regularly, such as jogging, swimming or football.
paragraphs.translation_id: Banyak orang berolahraga secara teratur, misalnya joging, berenang, atau sepak bola.

paragraphs.text: Auch die Ernährung ist wichtig: frisches Gemüse und Obst stehen oft auf dem Tisch.
paragraphs.translation: Diet is also important: fresh vegetables and fruit are often on the table.
paragraphs.translation_en: Diet is also important: fresh vegetables and fruit are often on the table.
paragraphs.translation_id: Makanan juga penting: sayur dan buah segar sering ada di meja.

paragraphs.text: Ärzte empfehlen außerdem, genug zu schlafen und Stress zu vermeiden.
paragraphs.translation: Doctors also recommend sleeping enough and avoiding stress.
paragraphs.translation_en: Doctors also recommend sleeping enough and avoiding stress.
paragraphs.translation_id: Dokter juga menyarankan tidur cukup dan menghindari stres.

paragraphs.text: Wenn jemand krank ist, geht er zuerst zum Hausarzt, bevor er einen Spezialisten aufsucht.
paragraphs.translation: If someone is ill, he first goes to the family doctor before seeing a specialist.
paragraphs.translation_en: If someone is ill, he first goes to the family doctor before seeing a specialist.
paragraphs.translation_id: Kalau ada yang sakit, pertama pergi ke dokter keluarga sebelum menemui dokter spesialis.

paragraphs.text: So bleibt man im besten Fall lange gesund.
paragraphs.translation: That way you stay healthy for a long time in the best case.
paragraphs.translation_en: That way you stay healthy for a long time in the best case.
paragraphs.translation_id: Dengan begitu kamu tetap sehat dalam waktu lama dalam kasus terbaik.

summary_en: How Germans take care of their health through sport, food and sleep.
summary_id: Bagaimana orang Jerman menjaga kesehatan lewat olahraga, makanan, dan tidur.

title: Digitales Lernen — Digital Learning
summary: A student talks about learning with apps and online courses.

paragraphs.text: Lena studiert an der Universität und lernt fast alles digital.
paragraphs.translation: Lena studies at the university and learns almost everything digitally.
paragraphs.translation_en: Lena studies at the university and learns almost everything digitally.
paragraphs.translation_id: Lena kuliah di universitas dan belajar hampir semua secara digital.

paragraphs.text: Sie benutzt eine Lernapp für Vokabeln und schaut sich Online-Kurse an.
paragraphs.translation: She uses a learning app for vocabulary and watches online courses.
paragraphs.translation_en: She uses a learning app for vocabulary and watches online courses.
paragraphs.translation_id: Dia memakai aplikasi belajar untuk kosakata dan menonton kursus daring.

paragraphs.text: Der Vorteil ist, dass sie überall und zu jeder Zeit lernen kann.
paragraphs.translation: The advantage is that she can learn anywhere and at any time.
paragraphs.translation_en: The advantage is that she can learn anywhere and at any time.
paragraphs.translation_id: Keuntungannya dia bisa belajar di mana saja dan kapan saja.

paragraphs.text: Ein Nachteil ist jedoch die Ablenkung durch das Smartphone.
paragraphs.translation: A disadvantage, however, is the distraction caused by the smartphone.
paragraphs.translation_en: A disadvantage, however, is the distraction caused by the smartphone.
paragraphs.translation_id: Namun kekurangannya adalah gangguan dari ponsel pintar.

paragraphs.text: Lena hat eine Regel: Während der Lernzeit bleibt das Handy in der Tasche.
paragraphs.translation: Lena has a rule: during study time the phone stays in the bag.
paragraphs.translation_en: Lena has a rule: during study time the phone stays in the bag.
paragraphs.translation_id: Lena punya aturan: selama waktu belajar ponsel tetap di tas.

paragraphs.text: So bleibt ihre Konzentration hoch und das Lernen macht mehr Spaß.
paragraphs.translation: That way her concentration stays high and learning is more fun.
paragraphs.translation_en: That way her concentration stays high and learning is more fun.
paragraphs.translation_id: Dengan begitu konsentrasinya tetap tinggi dan belajar lebih menyenangkan.

summary_en: A student talks about learning with apps and online courses.
summary_id: Seorang mahasiswa bercerita tentang belajar dengan aplikasi dan kursus daring.

title: Im Sportverein — In the Sports Club
summary: Why joining a club is a good way to meet people in Germany.

paragraphs.text: In Deutschland spielen Vereine eine wichtige Rolle im sozialen Leben.
paragraphs.translation: In Germany clubs play an important role in social life.
paragraphs.translation_en: In Germany clubs play an important role in social life.
paragraphs.translation_id: Di Jerman klub memegang peran penting dalam kehidupan sosial.

paragraphs.text: Es gibt Sportvereine, Musikvereine und sogar Gartenvereine.
paragraphs.translation: There are sports clubs, music clubs and even garden clubs.
paragraphs.translation_en: There are sports clubs, music clubs and even garden clubs.
paragraphs.translation_id: Ada klub olahraga, klub musik, bahkan klub kebun.

paragraphs.text: Wenn man neu in einer Stadt ist, kann man im Verein schnell Kontakte knüpfen.
paragraphs.translation: When you are new in a city, you can quickly make contacts in a club.
paragraphs.translation_en: When you are new in a city, you can quickly make contacts in a club.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saat baru di sebuah kota, kamu bisa cepat menjalin kenalan lewat klub.

paragraphs.text: Die Mitglieder treffen sich regelmäßig und organisieren gemeinsame Aktivitäten.
paragraphs.translation: The members meet regularly and organize joint activities.
paragraphs.translation_en: The members meet regularly and organize joint activities.
paragraphs.translation_id: Para anggota bertemu secara rutin dan mengorganisasi kegiatan bersama.

paragraphs.text: Die monatlichen Beiträge sind meistens niedrig.
paragraphs.translation: The monthly fees are usually low.
paragraphs.translation_en: The monthly fees are usually low.
paragraphs.translation_id: Iuran bulanannya biasanya murah.

paragraphs.text: Für viele ist der Verein wie eine zweite Familie.
paragraphs.translation: For many, the club is like a second family.
paragraphs.translation_en: For many, the club is like a second family.
paragraphs.translation_id: Bagi banyak orang, klub itu seperti keluarga kedua.

summary_en: Why joining a club is a good way to meet people in Germany.
summary_id: Mengapa bergabung dengan klub adalah cara yang baik untuk bertemu orang di Jerman.
